invariantRules.text: Objective, Metric Definition, Target, Observation, Outcome, Benefit and Deliverable remain distinct identities or referenced subjects.
WM-KNW-011 remains the Objective, Key Result and Target master; a Key Result is a measurable-progress role and not a new root.
Every quantitative target pins an exact Metric Definition revision, unit, operator, baseline period and target period; latest or bare-name references are invalid.
Metric redefinition never silently rewrites a target; it creates a successor binding with retained prior value and comparability note.
WM-XCT-025 is used only on qualified WM-MAT-008 observation hosts under an explicit usage rule and is never embedded in goals, assessments, Outcomes or Benefits.
Observation, deliverable acceptance, planned effect and KR attainment never by themselves prove an Outcome or realised Benefit.
Outcome and Benefit are separate potential roots with different identity, lifecycle and mastership; this boundary register allocates neither.
An Outcome asserts a subject state-change and horizon and cites qualified observations without owning measurement facts.
A Benefit identifies beneficiary, value kind, valuation profile and Outcome or counterfactual basis and is never owned by an Outcome write boundary.
Attribution Claim is a Benefit-owned revisable assertion and never rewrites Outcome, Observation or contributing work.
Adjudicated attribution shares for one Benefit and period cannot exceed one; residual unattributed contribution is explicit and permitted.
Program and constituent projects reference one Benefit identity and never create duplicate realised-Benefit records for the same value and period.
Benefit and Disbenefit are separately identifiable value records using a polarity code; neither is silently netted into the other.
Missing or delayed measurement carries an explicit absent reason and remains forecast or measurement-pending; it is never represented as zero or realised.
Value Assessment pins criteria, valuation profile, method, scale, evidence and uncertainty and may conclude valued, anti-valued, insufficient-evidence or incomparable.
Net value requires a declared commensuration method and loads related Disbenefits or explicitly declares them out of scope.
Uncertainty travels with observations, attribution claims and assessment conclusions and is never stripped by aggregation or comparison.
Superseded Objective bindings, Outcome assertions, Benefit claims and assessment conclusions remain resolvable and are never overwritten or recycled.

Realisation requires at least one qualified observation with final or amended status whose phenomenon time falls inside the declared realisation window; provisional or out-of-window observations do not license realisation.

A programme-level attribution claim and its constituent project claims cannot all be adjudicated for the same Benefit and period; the programme either holds the claim with project shares beneath it or holds none.
Every Attribution Claim carries contributor, method reference, as-of time, uncertainty interval, evidence references, adjudication status and causal limit; share is optional.
Ordinal, nominal and offset scales refuse scalar conversion even when a method is cited; incompatibility remains explicit.
WM-XCT-025 comparability advice is non-authoritative; scalar netting is a separately identified Value Assessment with its own method, evidence and uncertainty.
An Outcome may exist without an Objective and may serve multiple Objectives; forcing a one-to-one Objective containment is invalid.
The profile adds a Metric Definition revision pin absent from WM-KNW-011 fd-measure-binding and rejects any target whose pinned revision cannot be resolved.
Benefit and Disbenefit are separate records using one polarity-bearing candidate shape, not separate models; both require an Outcome or explicit counterfactual basis.
